name: Gaw Ha Leccee
source:
From: Heavy Metal L-Gaim
One of Daba's allies. A former member of Posaydal's Extra Thirteen, she was inspired to defect from the army by Daba's sense of character. An accomplished fighter with extensive knowledge of tactical warfare, Leccee wages countless high-stakes, do-or-die battles with Amm..over Daba's affections.
